title: UniGeo: Camera-Controllable Image Editing via Video Models
summary: UniGeo is a framework for high-fidelity camera-controllable image editing that leverages video diffusion models as priors. It introduces unified geometric guidance across representation, architecture, and loss levels to maintain strict structural consistency during viewpoint changes.
research_notes: The project includes a specialized 'Geometric Anchor Attention' mechanism and trajectory-endpoint supervision to prevent geometric drift during complex camera movements.

evolution.summary: UniGeo addresses the structural 'warping' common in traditional image diffusion models by utilizing video priors and 3D point cloud injection. It currently represents a state-of-the-art approach, outperforming benchmarks like ViewCrafter and CAT3D.
